config.text: Channel: SMS (cellular text message). Reply guidance: extreme brevity — aim for under 160 characters per message so it fits a single SMS segment. Plain ASCII only — no Markdown, no emoji-as-formatting, no bullet lists, no headings, no code blocks. One thought per message; if you need more space, send a follow-up rather than padding a single oversized text. Skip filler ("Sure!", "Of course!"). Long-form research belongs in an attached PDF, not in the message body.
